# Website languages

English and Hindi are written by hand next to every text in `tools/build_site.py` and the page modules.
Spanish (`es`), Portuguese (`pt`), French (`fr`) and Arabic (`ar`) are looked up by a short id.

* `source.tsv` lists every translatable text with its id (generated by `python3 tools/build_site.py`).
* `<lang>.tsv` holds `id<TAB>translation` lines for the texts that are translated.
* `arb_<lang>.json` holds the texts that the website scripts build in the browser (quiz, units, planet names).

A text without a translation shows in English, so a language can be completed step by step.
To add or fix a translation, edit the matching `.tsv` file and run `python3 tools/build_site.py`.
Arabic is shown right to left.
